**SYMMETRIC QUIVER HECKE ALGEBRAS R-MATRICES OF QUANTUM AFFINE ALGEBRAS**

*SEOK-JIN KANG 1, MASAKI KASHIW ARA2, MYUNGHO KIM 3*

83 pp, 32 sections.

**Abstract.** Let J be a set of pairs consisting of good U ′ q(g)-modules and invertible elements in the base ﬁeld C(q). The distribution of poles of normalized R-matrices yields Khovanov-Lauda-Rouquier algebras RJ (β) for each β∈ Q+. We deﬁne a func- torFβ from the category of graded RJ (β)-modules to the category of U ′ q(g)-modules. The functorF = ⨁ β ∈Q+Fβ sends convolution products of ﬁnite-dimensional graded RJ (β)-modules to tensor products of ﬁnite-dimensional U ′ q(g)-modules. It is exact if RJ is of ﬁnite type A, D, E. If V (̟1) is the fundamental representation of U ′ q(ˆslN ) of weight ̟1 and J = {( V (̟1), q2i) | i∈ Z } , then RJ is the Khovanov-Lauda-Rouquier algebra of type A∞.
